title: Accessibility Basics
description: Accessibility refers to designing websites so that they can be used by everyone, including individuals with disabilities.
Basic accessibility practices include adding alternative text to images, using labels for form fields, maintaining proper heading structures, and utilizing semantic HTML elements.
Following accessibility guidelines improves usability and ensures that all users can access and understand webpage content effectively.

example.output: Screen readers can describe the image and properly identify the email field for users with disabilities.
